implementation_identity: official uni2ts repository at pinned commit cfd46d4510ed8896f263116f32928eede05b0a75 (Moirai2Forecast/Moirai2Module); the PyPI uni2ts 2.0.0 wheel predates Moirai-2 and is NOT the implementation; Moirai 2.0-R-small weights, frozen, zero-shot (not Moirai 1.x, not Moirai-MoE)
paper_reference: Woo et al. Unified Training of Universal Time Series Forecasting Transformers (Moirai-2). arXiv:2511.11698, 2025

weights.sha256: see weights/weight_identities.json in the run worktree (recorded at download, 2026-10-23)

dependency_versions.uni2ts: 2.0.0 installed from git commit cfd46d4 (PyPI 2.0.0 wheel lacks Moirai-2)

input_mapping.history_values.price: un-standardized once via frozen train target mean/std -> past_target [72,1] raw RRP; output point is raw RRP
input_mapping.history_calendar+future_calendar: feat_dynamic_real [96,10] (field must span past+future; calendar is future-known)
input_mapping.unmapped_reason: Moirai-2 wrapper has no static field; future-only covariates lack the past span required by feat_dynamic_real
input_mapping.scope_declaration: input_scope=restricted_price_target_demand_past_covariate_calendar_past_future; NOT an equal-input comparison to full-1465-column models

output_quantiles.q05_q95: not available natively (verified from checkpoint config.json revision 30f43ff0); no extrapolation, endpoint copying or Gaussian tails
output_quantiles.auxiliary: native q10/q50/q90 exported per cell to auxiliary_quantiles.npz as diagnostics; never merged into a five-quantile score

native_behavior.dropout: forced to zero by Moirai2Forecast constructor

context_policy.context_source: each origin's own legal 72h price history plus as-of covariates
context_policy.test_labels: never visible to the adapter; scorer-only

randomness.seed_controls: nothing; frozen weights, no sampling path (quantile head only), dropout zero

differences_from_paper: paper evaluates on its own benchmarks; here zero-shot hourly NEM prices with restricted legal covariates; no benchmark score reproduction claimed
